# Telegram

> Connect Zenflow to Telegram to send messages, receive updates, and automate channel communications.

<span className="set-page-badge-native" />

<Note>
  This native integration requires a Zencoder account.
</Note>

## Overview

The Telegram integration lets the AI agent interact with Telegram chats, groups, and channels. Send messages, receive updates, post notifications, and automate communication workflows — all from within a Zenflow task.

## Connecting Telegram

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open Settings & Integrations">
    Navigate to **Settings → Integrations** in the Zenflow sidebar.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Find Telegram">
    Locate **Telegram** in the Integrations Catalog.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Click Connect">
    Click the **Connect** or **\[+]** button on the Telegram card.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Authorize Connection">
    Follow the prompts in the secure connection popup window to link your Telegram account or bot.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## What the Agent Can Do

* **Send messages** — Post messages to individual chats, groups, or channels
* **Read updates** — Monitor incoming messages and notifications
* **Automate notifications** — Send alerts, status updates, and summaries on a schedule
* **Manage conversations** — Track and respond to messages across multiple chats

## Example Use Cases

* Send daily standup summaries to a team Telegram group
* Post deployment notifications to an engineering channel
* Forward urgent email alerts to Telegram for faster response
* Automate customer support notifications

Browse ready-to-use templates in the **[Zencoder Marketplace](https://zencoder.ai/marketplace)**.
